name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Strategic Account Manager & B2B Sales Professional
summary: Strategic account manager and B2B sales professional with 15+ years growing high-value accounts across SaaS, MarTech, and technology — owning the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation, cross-sell/up-sell, and renewal. Consultative seller who pairs deep relationship-building with Salesforce pipeline discipline and data-driven account planning to consistently expand revenue. Entrepreneurial operator (founder of Solenzo) who thrives in remote, target-driven environments and travels to win and grow key accounts.

Run outbound prospecting and new-business development across email, calls, and targeted campaigns, building qualified pipeline from new and existing accounts.

Build performance dashboards and analyze account data — purchases, pipeline progression, and historical trends — translating results into account plans and growth actions.
Collaborate directly with business owners and sales teams to align programs with revenue objectives, ensuring consistent messaging and qualified lead flow.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating customer requirements into configurations and providing hands-on product training.
